name: UNDERTALE [FIGHT]
desc:
NEW ONE: https://www.roblox.com/games/16810653428/UNDERTALE-FIGHT-v0-09

SHUTDOWN(S) = UPDATE OR A QUICK FIX

NOTE: There might be quiet a few shutdowns since this is just a beta. Also, the ERASE cap is 3 for now.

This game is a free-for-all UNDERTALE battleground game. FIGHT others players and gain EXP and LV to unlock more characters with unique abilities and upgrades. If not feeling like to battle other players then you can try out singleplayer/story mode battles (which isn't out yet) for EXP, LV and new upgrades for certain characters.

GUI Controls:
Press E to enable/disable stats gui (main gui)
Press Q to enable/disable character gui
Press R to play/mute music
